Features.Features_and_Traits:
Flight (Owlin) - Flying speed equal to walking speed.

Telepathic Speech - Form a telepathic connection with any creature you can see.

Psionic Sorcery - Cast Aberrant Mind spells using Sorcery Points. When done, the spell requires NO verbal, somatic, or material components.

Metamagic Adept - Subtle Spell (cast without moving/speaking) and Twinned Spell (target two people with one single-target spell).

Sorcerous Restoration - Regain 4 expended sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.

Soul Bond - Can give or receive resources (Sorcery Points/Spell slots) from those she is Soul Bonded with (Dhalia and Valeria).

Celestial Resistance & Darkvision 120ft.

Details.Detailed_Background: Goddess of Memories and Queen of Memoria. Every once in a while, her curiosity overcomes her disdain for physical exertion. She became interested in this new realm to came to it after the Nexus Event. She watches over her children from a distance, only intervening it absolutely necessary. She prefers to spend time wrapper in her wife's arms but is still curious as to what this new world can offer.
